sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We thank you for your proposal and deeply value the trust between our companies over the years. Our team takes immense pride in the quality we deliver from our foundry to your operations. 

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are prepared to commit to the 24-month contract you requested to ensure stability, but in return we ask to settle the payment terms at 45 days. Under these conditions, we can adjust our offer to a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your revised offer and the constructive steps taken. 

For generations, our family foundry has prided itself on craft, reliability, and the strong ties we share with long-standing partners across our region. To reach an agreement, we can further adjust our price to €50.90 per unit for the 45-day payment term. We believe this reflects a fair compromise that honors our long-standing partnership.

Under our proposal, our Angebot stands at a price of €50.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this path forward serves both our companies well, and we look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Our family-run foundry has always valued the deep roots and long-standing partnership we share with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. To bring this negotiation to a successful close, we can offer a further concession to €50.30 per unit. Along with a price of €50.30 per unit, our offer includes a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

We trust this step reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership and allows us to finalize the contract. Our team stands ready to continue our craft for your operations.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
